_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to servers.json (gitignored) and fill in. The world seed is deliberately NOT shipped: a seed identifies the world and lets anyone regenerate it. Put the real value in servers.json.local, or in servers.json on your own machine. seed: null = unknown, which switches !seed and the slime math to ask-the-op mode rather than guessing on a wrong seed.
